description: Perform actions on a recording page (scroll, click, hover, type, press, select, wait, navigate). Actions are performed sequentially and recorded in the video.

actions.description: Array of actions to perform sequentially

delay.description: Typing delay between characters in ms (for type action, default 80)

key.description: Key to press, e.g. "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "Control+a" (for press action)

ms.description: Wait duration in ms (for wait action)

value.description: Option value to select (for select action on <select> elements)

x.description: Scroll X pixels (for scroll) or hover X coordinate (for hover)

y.description: Scroll Y pixels (for scroll) or hover Y coordinate (for hover)

name: interact_page
